text:
maya: T-minus 20 for prod cutover (EU midnight window). Quick readout: staging smoke green, canary at 10% in eu-west shows +12ms median tail for text gen but no errors. embeddings CPU spike on one pod. Pin list updated to v2026-03-21.
jon: SGTM. Confirm dedicated pools have v2-quant pinned?
alice: yep pinned on dedicated pools and reserve capacity enabled. deploy-bot shows commit c8f2a1d as active.
deploy-bot: [info] starting canary rollout -> 10% traffic -> monitor 5m -> auto-eval hooks enabled :robot_face:
sre-bot: perf snapshot: https://grafana.redwood/snapshot/xyz123 (canary vs baseline)
maya: Run quick smoke before ramp: `./scripts/smoke.sh --env prod --quick` — please post green before ramping to 30%.
lewis: release notes: https://docs.redwood/release/2026-03-21 — includes embedding quant fix and retry backoff.
jon: if errors >= 1% over 5m -> rollback plan: pin back to v2026-03-18 and reduce batch_size to 4. rollback command: ```
# rollback to previous tagged version
deploy-bot rollback --to v2026-03-18 --scope prod --force
``` 
alice: noted. Also prepping hotpatch branch for embeddings: hotpatch/emb-quant-03. If we see regressions we'll cut and apply via canary-exempt flow.
maya: also note config gate: `max_inflight_tokens=8k` enforced for this window. keep an eye on token service queue.
sre-bot: alert rule snapshot: errors > 0.8% triggers page. latency p95 > 300ms triggers slack-warning channel.
deploy-bot: canary at 10% healthy after 5m. metrics: errors 0.02%, p95 +14ms, memory stable.
jon: ok ramp to 30% in 10m if no change. I'll be on standby for rollback.
alice: starting ramp to 30% now. will monitor logs for embeddings pod 3 which had the spike.
lewis: adding a short blameless note in release channel about embeddings risk and hotpatch path.
maya: final check: are there any unpinned models or exceptions? If none, go for 30%.
alice: no unpinned models. exceptions: none.
maya: go for 30%.
deploy-bot: ramping to 30% -> monitoring hooks engaged.
sre-bot: quick smoke at 30% shows stable. minor jitter in embeddings tail but below alert threshold.
jon: thumbs up. leaving standby for 15m.
maya: logging final status in deck and tagging CS for next-day communication.
lewis: noted, will update release notes with hotpatch link.
deploy-bot: rollout complete to 100% over next 40m (staggered). continuing monitoring. :tada:
maya: thanks team — if anything pops, call the rollback lane and ping #oncall immediately. good job. :thumbsup:
